description: Use when the user asks which players in today's or tonight's NFL, college football, NBA, WNBA, MLB or NHL games have been the most consistent lately, e.g. reached a stat number in 9 or 10 of their last 10 games. Covers games that haven't started and leaves injured players out. Returns last-10 and last-5 counts and the average. Past results only, not predictions.

sport.description: One league, or leave empty for every sport with games today
